Generated Narrative: ImplementationGuide ee.fhir.vris

EEVRIS

The official URL for this implementation guide is: 

https://fhir.ee/vris/ImplementationGuide/ee.fhir.vris

extension.valueMarkdown: Automatically added as a dependency - all IGs depend on HL7 Terminology

resource.name: $patient-observations operation
resource.description: TEST Custom operation to retrieve all Observation resources for a specific patient in Estonian VRIS. Supports optional filtering by profile, category, code, and date range. (ee TEST Operatioon kõikide Observation ressursside pärimiseks VRIS-ist. Tagastab Bundle'i kõikide Observationitega, kus subject viitab antud patsiendile.)

resource.name: Additional identifier
resource.description: Extension for additional identifier. (ee Lisa-identifikaator)

resource.name: BiologicallyDerivedProduct: EE VRIS Embryo
resource.description: Profile for embryo. (ee Embrüo. NB! IGA embrüo on omaette ressurss!)

resource.name: BiologicallyDerivedProduct: EE VRIS Oocyte
resource.description: Profile for oocyte. (ee Bioloogiline materjal (munarakk/munarakud)

resource.name: BiologicallyDerivedProduct: EE VRIS Reproductive Tissue
resource.description: Profile for reproductive tissue (testicular tissue, ovarian tissue). Used mainly for fertility preservation. (ee Bioloogiline materjal (munandi kude, munasarja kude). Kasutatakse peamiselt viljakuse säilitamiseks.)

resource.name: BiologicallyDerivedProduct: EE VRIS Sperm
resource.description: Profile for sperm. (ee Bioloogiline materjal (Seemnerakud)

resource.name: Birth Sex
resource.description: Extension for birth sex. (ee Sünnisugu)

resource.name: CarePlan: EEVRIS Cycle
resource.description: Profile for capturing infertility treatment cycle(s) on woman. (ee Ravisükkel. VÄRSKE või KÜLMUTATUD-SULATATUD)

resource.name: Cell origin role
resource.description: Extension for the role of donor/recipient of biological material. (ee Sperma/munaraku doonori/retsipiendi roll (viljatusravi saav naine, mittepartnerannetaja, partner, anonüümne, säilitaja jne).)

resource.name: Cell preservation reason
resource.description: Extension for the reason of cell preservation. (ee Sperma/munaraku säilitamise põhjus. (Nt meditsiiniline, mittemeditsiiniline jne))

resource.name: Condition: EE VRIS Birth Defect
resource.description: Congenital birth defect of newborn child. (ee Lapse väärarend. NB! Tulevikus kasutada diagnoosi-teenuse viidet!)

resource.name: Condition: EE VRIS Cause of Death
resource.description: Profile for capturing cause and time of death. (ee Surma põhjus. NB! Tulevikus kasutada diagnoosi-teenuse viidet!)

resource.name: Condition: EE VRIS Comorbidity
resource.description: Condition profile for comorbidities of a donor or recipient in the Estonian VRIS fertility system. (ee Kaasuv haigus. NB! Tulevikus viidata Diagnoosi-teenusele!)

resource.name: Condition: EE VRIS Condition Pregnancy
resource.description: Condition profile for pregnancy in Estonian VRIS fertility system. (ee Rasedus kui näidustus, diagnoos. NB! Tulevikus viidata Diagnoosi-teenusele!)

resource.name: Condition: EE VRIS Donor Genetic Finding
resource.description: Genetic finding of cell donor that appears later in life. (ee Tagantjärgi ilmnenud doonori geneetiline haigus või kandlus. NB! Tulevikus viidata Diagnoosi-teenusele!)

resource.name: Condition: EE VRIS Female Fertility Treatment Indication
resource.description: Clinical indication or diagnosis that is the reason for infertility treatment for Female. (ee NAISE kunstliku viljastamise näidustus, kliiniline diagnoos või seisund, mis on viljatusravi põhjus. NB! Tulevikus viidata Diagnoosi-teenusele!)

resource.name: Condition: EE VRIS Fertility Treatment Complication
resource.description: Complication related to fertility treatment. (ee Viljatusraviga seotud (haiglaravi vajavad?) tüsistused. NB! Tulevikus kasutada diagnoosi-teenuse viidet!)

resource.name: Condition: EE VRIS Male Fertility Treatment Indication
resource.description: Clinical indication or diagnosis that is the reason for infertility treatment for Male. (ee MEHE kunstliku viljastamise näidustus, kliiniline diagnoos või seisund, mis on viljatusravi põhjus. NB! Tulevikus viidata Diagnoosi-teenusele!)

resource.name: Coverage
resource.description: Extension for Tervisekassa coverage existence. (ee Kas (teenusel/ravil/tsüklil/vm on/ei ole Tervisekassa poolset kompensatsiooni patsiendile.)

resource.name: Coverage: EE VRIS Coverage
resource.description: Coverage profile for fertility treatment in Estonian VRIS. Identifies the payer of treatment (Health Insurance Fund or self-pay). (ee Viljatusravi rahastamise allikas, Tervisekassa või omaosalus. KAS teeme selle profiiliga või lihtsa extensioni?)

resource.name: Cryopreservation date
resource.description: Extension for cryopreservation date. (ee Bioloogilise materjali külmutamise (krüopreservatsiooni) kuupäev.)

resource.name: Cycle Discontinuation Reason
resource.description: Reason for fertility treatment cycle discontinuation. (ee Ravitsükli katkestamise põhjus.)

resource.name: donor-embryo1
resource.description: Example of embryo

resource.name: donor-genetic-finding-suspected1
resource.description: Example of suspected condition of genetic disorder of donor

resource.name: donor-genetic-finding-verified1
resource.description: Example of confirmed condition of donor's genetic disorder

resource.name: Encounter: EE VRIS Encounter
resource.description: Simple encounter profile for VRIS fertility treatment visits. (ee Visiidi ehk KONTAKTI profiil viljatusravi kontekstis. NB! Tulevikus tuleb viidata Encounter-EoC teenusele!)

resource.name: EpisodeOfCare: EE VRIS Episode of Care
resource.description: Episode of care profile for VRIS fertility treatment. Groups related encounters, procedures and observations within a longer treatment period. (ee Viljatusravi episood ühendab ravitsükli piires toimuvad visiidid, protseduurid ja vaatlused. NB! Tulevikus viidata Encounter-Episode teenusele!)

resource.name: EpisodeOfCare: EE VRIS EpisodeOfCare Pregnancy
resource.description: EpisodeOfCare profile for the WHOLE pregnancy, starting before conception and ending with childbirth. (ee Raseduse kogu elukaar. NB! Profiil peab järgima Encounter-EoC tuleviku struktuuri!).

resource.name: female-fertility-indication-example1
resource.description: Example of a female fertility treatment indication: anovulation disorder (ICD-10: N97.0).

resource.name: IVF tsükkel #1 Märts 2025
resource.description: Example of a fresh IVF treatment cycle CarePlan for female recipient.

resource.name: MedicationAdministration: EE VRIS Medication administred during procedure(s)
resource.description: Profile for medication administration during infertility procedure(s). (ee Viljatusravi ajal manustatud ravim(id).)

resource.name: medicationAdministrationFollitropin1
resource.description: Example of follitropin administration during ovarian stimulation for IVF cycle

resource.name: observation-bloodgroup
resource.description: Example of bloodgroup

resource.name: observation-embryo-lifecycle-counts
resource.description: Example of embryo lifecycle counts summary for IVF cycle

resource.name: observation-fertilization-counts
resource.description: Example of laboratory fertilization counts after IVF cycle

resource.name: observation-stimulation-protocol
resource.description: Example of ovarian stimulation protocol for IVF cycle

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Attempting to Concieve
resource.description: Observation profile for how long is woman attempting to concieve. (ee Rasestuda üritamine.)

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Biochemical Pregnancy
resource.description: Biochemical pregnancy detected by blood test. (ee Biokeemiline rasedus, tuvastatud vereanalüüsiga.)

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Birth Weight
resource.description: Birth weight of newborn child. (ee Lapse sünnikaal grammides.)

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Blood Group
resource.description: Observation profile for recording the ABO and Rh(D) blood group in the Estonian VRIS fertility system. (ee Veregrupp.)

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Clinical Pregnancy
resource.description: Clinical pregnancy, confirmed by ultrasound AND number of fetus. (ee Kliiniline rasedus, kinnitatud ultraheliuuringuga. LOOTEMUNADE arv ka! NB! Biokeemilise raseduse profiil on eraldi.)

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Education Level
resource.description: Education level of a donor or recipient in the Estonian VRIS fertility system. (ee Haridustase. NB! Pärimisel kasutada MPI profiili, sisestamisel või kui patsienti pole rahvastikuregistris, kasuta VRIS profiili.)

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Embryo Lifecycle Counts
resource.description: Summary counts of embryo lifecycle events in a fertility treatment cycle (frozen, transferred, destroyed). (ee Embrüote elutsükli kokkuvõtted: külmutatud, siirdatud, hävitatud arv tsüklis.)

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Fertilization Counts
resource.description: Counts of oocytes used and fertilized during fertilization procedure. (ee Viljastamise protseduuri munarakkude arvud erinevates staadiumites.)

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Fetus Reduction
resource.description: Observation profile for recording whether fetus reduction procedure was performed in multifetal pregnancy. (ee Loote/loodete reduktsiooni läbiviimine mitmikrasedusel.)

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Height
resource.description: Observation profile for recording height of a donor in the Estonian VRIS fertility system. (ee Pikkus.)

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Marital Status
resource.description: Marital status of a donor or recipient in the Estonian VRIS fertility system. (ee Perekonnaseis. NB! Pärimisel kasutada MPI profiili, sisestamisel või kui patsienti pole rahvastikuregistris, kasuta VRIS profiili.)

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Neonatal Intensive Care
resource.description: Whether the child received neonatal intensive care during first 7 days of life. (ee Lapse intensiivravi esimese 7 elupäeva jooksul.)

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Obstetric History
resource.description: Past obstetric history at the START of fertility treatment cycle. Records cumulative count of all prior pregnancies, deliveries, live births and stillbirths BEFORE current treatment. (ee Sünnitusanamnees ENNE käesolevat viljatusravi tsüklit. Varasemate raseduste, sünnituste ja sündide kumulatiivne arv.)

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Ovarian Stimulation Protocol
resource.description: Captures ovarian stimulation protocol details for fertility treatment cycle. (ee Munasarjade stimulatsiooni protokoll sisaldab meetodi, supressiooni, gonadotropiini ja eelneva ravi info.)

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Physical Appearance
resource.description: Observation profile for recording characteristics of physical appearance of donor. (ee Profiil on mõeldud välimust kirjeldavate karakteristikute jaoks, nt silmade värd, juuste värv, naha värv, kehaehitus.)

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Pregnancy Outcome
resource.description: Pregnancy outcome including delivery, miscarriage, abortion details. (ee Raseduse lõpe sünnitus, katkemine või katkestamine koos detailidega.)

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Prenatal Care Discontinued
resource.description: Indicator whether prenatal care was discontinued by patient or for unknown reasons. (ee Rasedusaegne tervisekontroll katkestatud patsiendi poolt või teadmata põhjusel.)

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Prior Fertility Treatment
resource.description: Prior fertility treatment history. Records whether IVF and/or IUI has been performed and the number of cycles. (ee Varasema viljatusravi anamnees)

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Stimulation Protocol for Embryo Transfer
resource.description: Captures stimulation protocol details for thawed embryo. (ee Sulatatud embrüo siirdamise protokoll jm.)

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Tobacco Use
resource.description: Observation profile for tobacco use status in the Estonian VRIS fertility system. (ee Tubakatoodete kasutamine.)

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Waist
resource.description: Observation profile for recording waist circumference of a donor in the Estonian VRIS fertility system. (ee Vööümbermõõt.)

resource.name: Observation: EE VRIS Weight
resource.description: Observation profile for recording weight of a donor in the Estonian VRIS fertility system. (ee Kaal.)

resource.description: Example of oocyte

resource.description: Example Organization. (ee Näidis-Asutus. NB! Hiljem tuleb vahetada SPD vastu!)

resource.description: Example of packaged sperm containing 3 doses.

resource.description: Profile for packaged doses of reproductive cells. (ee Suguraku pakendite profiil)

resource.name: Patient: EE VRIS Anonymous Patient
resource.description: Anonymous donor in the Estonian VRIS fertility system. (ee Anonüümne (välismaa) doonor VRIS-is.)

resource.name: Patient: EE VRIS Child
resource.description: Child born from VRIS fertility treatment. (ee VRIS viljatusravi tulemusena sündinud laps. ISIKUKOOD teada!)

resource.name: Patient: EE VRIS Child
resource.description: Child born from VRIS fertility treatment with UNKNOWN ID (and NO name) Identifier is generated by HC provider. (ee VRIS viljatusravi tulemusena sündinud laps. ISIKUKOOD teadMATA! IK genereeritud TTO poolt.)

resource.name: Patient: EE VRIS Donor
resource.description: For use of donors. (ee Doonori profiil, kasutamiseks. Anonüümsete ja anonüümsete-välismaiste doonorite puhul on TEINE PROFIIL!)

resource.name: Patient: EE VRIS Patient
resource.description: VRIS patient profile. (ee EI KASUTA! VRIS patsiendi profiil. Roll modifierExtension'ina ning link viitab MPI ametlikule patsiendikirjele.)

resource.name: Patient: EE VRIS Recipient
resource.description: For use of patients who recieve care and are recipients of biologic material. (ee retsipienti profiil. NB! alati MPI-s registreeritud. NB! Kas partner on retsipient?)

resource.description: Example of child born from VRIS fertility treatment

resource.description: Example of known Estonian male sperm donor

resource.description: Example of anonymous foreign sperm donor

resource.description: Example of verified female patient

resource.description: Example of Practitioner D99876

resource.description: Example of doctor (PractitionerRole D99876) working at NovaVita

resource.description: Example of fresh embryo transfer procedure

resource.description: Example of IVF fertilization procedure using donor sperm

resource.description: Example of oocyte retrieval procedure in IVF cycle March 2025

resource.name: Procedure: EE VRIS Cryopreservation
resource.description: Profile for cryopreservation of biological material (sperm, oocyte, embryo). (ee Bioloogilise materjali külmutamise protseduur.)

resource.name: Procedure: EE VRIS Destruction
resource.description: Profile for destruction of biological material (sperm, oocyte, embryo, reproductive tissue). (ee Bioloogilise materjali hävitamise protseduur.)

resource.name: Procedure: EE VRIS Donation
resource.description: Profile for donation of biological material (sperm, oocyte, reproductive tissue). (ee Bioloogilise materjali annetamise protseduur. KAS seda on vaja?)

resource.name: Procedure: EE VRIS Embryo Transfer
resource.description: Procedure for embryo transfer to recipient. Records transfer date, number of embryos, outcome, or reason for non-transfer. (ee Embrüo siirdamise protseduur.)

resource.name: Procedure: EE VRIS Fertilization
resource.description: Profile for oocyte fertilization procedure using IVF, ICSI, or both methods. (ee Munarakkude viljastamise protseduur.)

resource.name: Procedure: EE VRIS Intrauterine Insemination (IUI)
resource.description: Profile for intrauterine insemination procedure sperm directly introduced into the uterine cavity. (ee Emakasisene inseminatsioon (IUI).)

resource.name: Procedure: EE VRIS Oocyte Retrieval
resource.description: Profile for oocyte retrieval (ovarian puncture) procedure. (ee Munasarjade punktsioon munarakkude saamise protseduur.)

resource.name: Procedure: EE VRIS Preimplantation Genetic Testing
resource.description: Procedure for preimplantation genetic testing (PGT) of embryos. (ee Embrüodiagnostika protseduur enne siirdamist.)

resource.name: Procedure: EE VRIS Procedure
resource.description: Base profile for Procedure. For each specific procedure use their profiles(freezing, destroying, donating, dispensing etc)... (ee Baasprofiil erinevate protseduuride kirjeldamiseks. (Nt. Külmutamine, annetamine...))

resource.name: Re-cryopreservation date and count
resource.description: Extension for re-cryopreservation information. (ee Bioloogilise materjali taaskülmutamine ja arv.)

resource.name: Related clinic
resource.description: Extension for related (fertility) clinic who has more rights to see their patient data. (ee Patsiendiga seotud (viljatusravikliinik)/TTO)

resource.name: Related person reference
resource.description: Extension for referencing related person. (ee Viide seotud isikule/doonorile.)

resource.name: RelatedPerson: EE VRIS RelatedPerson
resource.description: Related person profile for VRIS. (ee Seotud isiku profiil näitab seost patsiendi või retsipiendiga. Doonori ja retsipiendi vahelise SUHTE kirjeldus.)

resource.name: sperm1
resource.description: Example of donor spermn

resource.description: Extension for describing which stimulation method is/was used. (ee Bioloogilise materjali stimulatsiooni meetod.)

resource.name: Supplied package reference
resource.description: Extension for referencing supplied package. (ee Viide väljastatud/vastuvõetud pakendile.)

resource.name: SupplyDelivery: EE VRIS Biological material movement
resource.description: Use this profile for describing when the biological material (sperm, oocyte, embryo) is transferred from one place to another. (ee Eestis annetatud bioloogiline materjali (sperma, munarakud, embrüo) liikumine TTO-sse/sealt välja

resource.name: supplyDeliverySperm1
resource.description: Example of sperm package delivery from Nova Vita to PERH, 4 doses of donor sperm

resource.name: Thawing date and count
resource.description: Extension for thawing information. (ee Bioloogilise materjali sulatamise kuupäev ja arv.)
